title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.6.1 is a teaching and reproducibility audit of the v1.6.0 course release (Weeks 1 to 15). It adds definitions, notation and worked examples to the Week 1, 7.2, 9.3, 10.1, 11, 12, 14 and 15 lectures; rebuilds the Week 13 rectangular-cavity PINN notebook in teaching order with a CPU training exercise judged by training loss, held-out residual and CFD field error; repairs the beginner notebook path (P0 dataset hash, Week 4 Lab 2 dataset fallback, Week 3 GPU batch runner); removes private and upload-era context from public notebooks; adds robust-scale Week 12 heat-flux figures beside the retained full-range evidence; and makes the release QA index-driven (every notebook and lecture PDF must be listed in the launcher pages). Retained scientific gates and limitations are preserved; matched CFD validation of the deep-cavity PINN cases is still not claimed. Upstream research sources and dataset permissions remain separately attributed.
